QuestInfo.name: Alcaster's Laboratory
QuestInfo.0: What does #b#p2020005##k know about the Black Mage and the heroes?
QuestInfo.1: #p2020005# knows a bit, even though he wasn't around back then. Apparently his teacher used to know a lot more and his records are in the laboratory, which is closed now.\r\n\r\n#e#b<If you fail to complete the quest, forfeit and start again.>#k#n
QuestInfo.2: #p2020005#'s Laboratory was taken over by the Black Wings and his teacher's diary is gone. #p2020005# could not figure out why anyone would want to break in there.

0.0: I've heard a lot about the Black Mage's reign. I hadn't even been born yet, but I had a wonderful teacher. He told me many times about the great heroes that bought peace with their own lives...
0.1: Are you interested in those long-passed days? What an interesting young person you are. Well, since Empress #p1101000# came to us, the heroes are a lot more well-known than they once were. Before that, I'd thought they'd been forgotten!
0.2: You know, I worked in an #bold laboratory that was closed#k some time ago. My journals and records should be there, and they include notes from my old teacher. If you want, I can show you the way there in #m200081700#.\r\n#b#e<You will be moved if you accept.>#n#k

yes.0: The laboratory is in #b#m200081700##k. If you can find those journals under all the dust, it might be of help.

no.0: Oh, I thought I'd finally found a pupil...

1.0: Hmm, someone broke into that old lab? Why in the world would anyone go into that old dust trap?

yes.0: You didn't even find the old journal did you?

default.0: Be careful in the old laboratory. It's quite a mess.
